title: Accessing Data
text: strollur package includes several functions access sequence data. strollur::names() - names function extension base R’s names function. allows get name dataset names sequences, bins, samples, treatments reports dataset. strollur::count() - count function allows get number sequences, bins, samples treatments dataset. strollur::abundance() - abundance function can used access abundance data sequences, bins, samples, treatments. strollur::report() - report function can used access various data associated dataset. strollur::summary() - summary function allows summarize sequences, custom reports, scrapped data.

title: Accessing Data
text: strollur::names() function allows get names sequences, bins, samples, treatments reports. Let’s take closer look use . get name dataset, set type parameter dataset: get names sequences dataset, set type parameter sequence: get names sequences present sample ‘F3D0’: get names sequences exclusive sample ‘F3D0’: get names bins dataset, need specify bin_type. miseq example contains 3 bin types: otu, asv phylotype. Let’s find bin names ‘otu’ bin type. get names ‘otu’ bins include sequences present sample ‘F3D0’: get names “otu” bins exclusive sample ‘F3D0’: get names samples, set type parameter sample. get names treatments, set type parameter treatment. get names custom reports, set type parameter report.
code: strollur::names(miseq, type = "dataset") #> [1] "miseq_sop" all_sequences <- strollur::names(   miseq,   type = "sequence",   distinct = FALSE ) length(all_sequences) #> [1] 2425 head(all_sequences, n = 5) #> [1] "M00967_43_000000000-A3JHG_1_2101_16474_12783" #> [2] "M00967_43_000000000-A3JHG_1_1113_12711_3318"  #> [3] "M00967_43_000000000-A3JHG_1_2108_14707_9807"  #> [4] title: Accessing Data
text: strollur::count() function allows get number sequences, bins, samples treatments dataset. find total number sequences dataset, run following: find number unique sequences dataset, set distinct = TRUE: get total number sequences present sample ‘F3D0’, can set samples parameter. Note, sequences present sample may present samples well. get number unique sequences exclusive sample ‘F3D0’: get number bins dataset, need specify bin_type. miseq example contains 3 bin types: otu, asv phylotype. Let’s find number bins ‘otu’ bin type. get number otu bins sequences present sample ‘F3D0’: Note bins sequences sample ‘F3D0’ may contain  sequences samples well. get number otu bins exclusive sample ‘F3D0’: Note bins sequences sample ‘F3D0’ samples  present bins. get number samples dataset, set type = sample: get number treatments dataset, set type = treatment:
code: strollur::count(   miseq,   type = "sequence",   distinct = FALSE ) #> [1] 113963 strollur::count(   miseq,   type = "sequence",   distinct = TRUE ) #> [1] 2425 strollur::count(   miseq,   type = "sequence",   samples = c("F3D0"),   distinct = FALSE ) #> [1] 6191 strollur::count(   miseq,   type = "sequence",   samples = c("F3D0"),   distinct = TRUE ) #> [1] 101 strollur::count(   miseq,   type = "bin",   bin_type = "otu" ) #> [1] 531 strollur::count(   miseq,   type = "bin",   bin_type = "otu",   samples = c("F3D0"),   distinct = FALSE ) #> [1] 191 strollur::count(   miseq,   type = "bin",   bin_type = "otu",   samples = c("F3D0"),   distinct = TRUE ) #> [1] 14 strollur::count(miseq, type = "sample") #> [1] 19 strollur::count(miseq, type = "treatment") #> [1] 2

title: Accessing Data
text: Now familiar strollur::names() strollur::count() functions. Let’s learn can use strollur::abundance() function. abundance function can used access abundance data sequences, bins, samples, treatments. returns data.frame containing requested abundance data. total abundance sequence, set type = sequence. return 2 column data.frame containing sequence_names abundances. abundance sequence parsed sample, set by_sample = TRUE. return 3 4 column data.frame containing sequence_names, abundances, samples treatments (assigned). get total abundance bins dataset, need specify bin_type. miseq example contains 3 bin types: otu, asv phylotype. Let’s find abundance data bins otu bin type. return 2 column data.frame containing bin_names abundances. abundance bin parsed sample, set by_sample = TRUE. return 3 4 column data.frame containing bin_names, abundances, samples treatments (assigned). access distribution sequences across samples dataset, set type = sample. return 2 column data.frame containing sample names abundances. access distribution sequences across treatments dataset, set type = treatment. return 2 column data.frame containing treatment names abundances.

title: Accessing Data
text: strollur::report() function allows access access FASTA sequences, sequence classification reports, bin assignments, sample assignments, metadata, phylo trees, sequence data reports, custom reports, resource references scrapped data reports. returns data.frame tree containing requested report data. Let’s look examples together. get report containing sequences FASTA data, set type = fasta. 2 3 column data.frame containing sequence names, sequence nucleotide strings, comments (provided). want take closer look sequences, can request report containing sequence names, starts, ends, lengths, ambiguous bases, longest homopolymers, number N’s. get sequence report, set type = sequence. report function also allows access classification reports dataset. 2 types classification reports: sequence_taxonomy bin_taxonomy. get report sequence classifications, set type = sequence_taxonomy. create 3 4 column report containing sequence names, taxonomic levels, taxons confidence scores(provided). get consensus taxonomies assigned bins dataset, need specify bin_type. miseq example contains 3 bin types: otu, asv phylotype. Let’s find consensus taxonomies bins otu bin type. get sequence bin assignments otu bins, run following: get sample treatment assignments, set type = sample_assignment. assigned bin representative sequences, can access report setting type = bin_representative. miseq example includes bin representatives otu bins. Let’s take look: miseq example contains custum report. access custom reports, first let’s find names. access custom contigs assembly report, set type = contigs_report. get metadata associated dataset, set type = metadata. get resource references associated dataset, set type = resource_reference. strollur allows include trees relating sequences samples within dataset. can access plot using following functions. access tree relates sequences dataset, set type = sequence_tree. access tree relates samples dataset, set type = sample_tree.  Lastly, sequences bins removed course analysis can see report scrapped data setting type = sequence_scrap type = bin_scrap. miseq example include scrapped data, let’s take look access .

text: Let’s create strollur object mothur’s Miseq SOP Example output files.
code: strollur_data <- strollur::read_mothur(   fasta = strollur_example("final.fasta.gz"),   count = strollur_example("final.count_table.gz"),   design = strollur_example("mouse.time.design"),   otu_list = strollur_example("final.opti_mcc.list.gz"),   asv_list = strollur_example("final.asv.list.gz"),   phylo_list = strollur_example("final.tx.list.gz"),   sample_tree = strollur_example("final.opti_mcc.jclass.ave.tre"),   sequence_tree = strollur_example("final.phylip.tre.gz"),   dataset_name = "miseq_sop" ) #> Added 2425 sequences. #> Assigned 2425 sequence abundances. #> Assigned 531 otu bins. #> Assigned 2425 asv bins. #> Assigned 63 phylotype bins. #> Assigned 19 samples to treatments.  metadata <- readRDS(strollur_example("miseq_metadata.rds")) strollur::add(strollur_data, table = metadata,               type = "report", report_type = "metadata") #> Added a metadata report.

title: Example Analysis Across Software Tools
text: phylotypr provides R-based implementation naive Bayesian Classifier. designed maintained Schloss Lab accepts strollur object input classify_sequences function. also includes built reference databases use.
code: database_reference <- phylotypr::build_kmer_database(trainset9_pds) phylotypr::classify_sequences(strollur_data, database_reference)

title: Example Analysis Across Software Tools
text: can use strollur’s write functions create phyloseq object strollur object calculate Shannon Index Principal Coordinates Analysis (PCoA) values using phyloseq.
code: phyloseq_data <- strollur::write_phyloseq(strollur_data) phyloseq_data #> phyloseq-class experiment-level object #> otu_table()   OTU Table:         [ 2425 taxa and 19 samples ] #> sample_data() Sample Data:       [ 19 samples by 2 sample variables ] #> phy_tree()    Phylogenetic Tree: [ 2425 tips and 2424 internal nodes ]  alpha_div <- phyloseq::estimate_richness(phyloseq_data,   measures = "Shannon" )  metadata <- data.frame(sample_data(phyloseq_data)) shannon_plot_data <- cbind(metadata, Shannon = alpha_div$Shannon)  ps_rel <- phyloseq::transform_sample_counts(   phyloseq_data,   function(x) x / sum(x) ) pcoa_ord <- phyloseq::ordinate(ps_rel, method = "PCoA", distance = "bray")

what: Plot the Shannon Alpha Diversity as a boxplot:
title: Example Analysis Across Software Tools
code: ggplot2::ggplot(shannon_plot_data, aes(   x = treatment,   y = Shannon,   fill = treatment )) +   geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.7, outlier.shape = NA) +   geom_jitter(width = 0.2, size = 2, alpha = 0.5) +   scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Set2") +   labs(     title = "Alpha Diversity",     x = "Experimental Group",     y = "Shannon Diversity Score"   ) +   theme_bw() +   theme(     legend.position = "none",     plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),     axis.text = element_text(size = 11),     axis.title = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold")   )

title: Functions for package developers

First get abundance table whole data set create inputs strollur::xdev_set_abundances(). can see sequences ‘F3D0’ removed. majority sequences data set present multiple samples. mothur2 uses strollur::xdev_set_abundances running mothur2::pre_cluster() function, sequences clustered sample, abundances set accordingly.

text: course analyzing data, may times want merge sequence abundances. sequence nucleotide string identical can save time processing merging identical read’s abundances. mothur2 merges sequences abundances mothur2::unique_seqs() function. miseq example includes merged sequences assigned bins. practice, merge sequences assigning bins. Note, code set ‘eval=FALSE’ can merge sequences assigned bin throw errors accordingly. Let’s take look use strollur::xdev_merge_sequences() function reference. title: Functions for package developers

title: General Importing
text: First let’s create empty data set named my_data.
code: data <- strollur::new_dataset(dataset_name = "my_data")

title: General Importing
text: strollur package includes two functions allow add sequence data. strollur::add() - add function allows add sequences, reports, metadata, resource references data set. strollur::assign() - assign function allows assign sequence abundances, sequence classifications, bins, bin representative sequences, bin classifications, samples treatments data set.

title: General Importing
text: strollur::add() function allows add sequences, reports, metadata, trees resource references data set.

title: General Importing

title: General Importing
text: may want add custom reports data set contigs assembly report, chimera report alignment report. can setting type = report. must also provide report_type. also good time explain table_names parameter . strollur expects columns custom reports specific names. table’s names differ strollur expecting, see error like . can use table_names parameter tell strollur specific column called custom report table. contigs_report sequence_name column called Name, add one line add function. Note, report tied sequence names report filtered remove sequences removed dataset.

text: can add additional resource references data set setting type = resource_reference.

title: General Importing
text: Lastly, strollur allows add trees relate samples sequences. Let’s look examples together.
code: sample_tree <- ape::read.tree(strollur_example("final.opti_mcc.jclass.ave.tre")) sequence_tree <- ape::read.tree(strollur_example("final.phylip.tre.gz"))  strollur::add(data, table = sample_tree, type = "sample_tree") #> → Your dataset does not contain sample data, ignoring sample tree. strollur::add(data, table = sequence_tree, type = "sequence_tree")  #| fig.alt: > #|   Plot of Miseq_SOP's sample relationship tree old_par <- par(bg = "white") ape::plot.phylo(sample_tree,   no.margin = TRUE,   cex = 0.5, edge.color = "maroon", tip.color = "navy" ) par(old_par)

title: Store and Transfer Amplicon Sequence Data
text: strollur package stores data associated Amplicon Sequence Analysis. includes nucleotide sequences, abundance, sample treatment assignments, taxonomic classifications, sequence bin assignments, metadata, trees various reports. designed facilitate data analysis across multiple R packages utility functions import mothur, qiime2, dada2 phyloseq. add() adds sequences, reports, metadata, resource references assign() assigns abundances, classifications, bins, samples treatments names() gets names sequences, bins, samples, treatments reports count() gets number sequences, bins, samples treatments abundance() gets abundances sequences, bins, samples, treatments report() gets FASTA sequences, sequence classification reports, bin assignments, sample assignments, metadata, sequence data reports, custom reports, resource references scrapped data reports. summary() summarizes sequences, custom reports, scrapped data

Add FASTA sequence data strollur::add(data = data, table = fasta_data, type = "sequence") #> Added 2425 sequences.  # To add FASTA data with a resource reference  # Create a new empty strollur object named 'example_dataset' data <- strollur::new_dataset(dataset_name = "example_dataset")  # Create a resource reference for the FASTA data silva_resource <- silva_resource <- strollur::new_reference(   vendor = "SILVA", name =     "silva.bacteria.fasta", version = "1.38.1",   usage = "alignment of sequences",   note = "reference trimmed to V4 region", method_url =     "https://mothur.org/blog/2024/SILVA-v138_2-reference-files/",   documentation_url = "https://mothur.org/wiki/silva_reference_files/" )  # Add FASTA data with a resource reference  strollur::add(   data,   table = fasta_data,   type = "sequence",   reference = silva_resource ) #> Added 2425 sequences. #> Added 1 resource references.  # Create a new empty strollur object named 'example_dataset' data <- strollur::new_dataset(dataset_name = "example_dataset")  # Read FASTQ data into data.frame fastq_data <-   strollur::read_fastq(fastq = strollur_example("tiny.fastq.gz"))  # Add FASTQ sequence data strollur::add(data = data, table = fastq_data, type = "fastq") #> Added 3 sequences. #> Assigned 3 quality scores.  # Add contigs assembly report with a 'sequence_name' column named 'Name'  contigs_report <- readRDS(strollur_example("miseq_contigs_report.rds"))  strollur::add(   data,   table = contigs_report, type = "report",   report_type = "contigs_report", list(sequence_name = "Name") ) #>  #> Your report does not contain an entry for every sequence in your dataset, ignoring report.   # To add metadata related to your study  metadata <- readRDS(strollur_example("miseq_metadata.rds"))  strollur::add(data,   table = metadata,   type = "report", report_type = "metadata" ) #> Added a metadata report.  # To add a tree relating to your sequences  tree <- ape::read.tree(strollur_example("final.phylip.tre.gz"))  strollur::add(data, table = tree, type = "sequence_tree") #> → Your tree does not contain a node for every sequence in your dataset, ignoring tree. Missing tree nodes for: M00967:43:000000000-A3JHG:1:1101:18327:1699, M00967:43:000000000-A3JHG:1:1101:14069:1827, M00967:43:000000000-A3JHG:1:1101:18044:1900 .  # To add a tree relating to your samples data <- strollur::new_dataset(dataset_name = "example_dataset")  df <- strollur::read_mothur_shared(strollur_example("final.opti_mcc.shared")) tree <- ape::read.tree(strollur_example("final.opti_mcc.jclass.ave.tre"))  strollur::assign(data, table = df, type = "bin", bin_type = "otu") #> Assigned 531 otu bins. strollur::add(data, table = tree, type = "sample_tree")

code: # Assign sequence classifications  # create a new empty strollur object named 'example_dataset' data <- strollur::new_dataset(dataset_name = "example_dataset")  sequence_classifications <- strollur::read_mothur_taxonomy(strollur_example(   "final.taxonomy.gz" ))  strollur::assign(   data,   table = sequence_classifications, type = "sequence_taxonomy" ) #> Assigned 2425 sequence taxonomies.  # Assigning bins  # read mothur's otu list file into data.frame otu_data <- strollur::read_mothur_list(list = strollur_example(   "final.opti_mcc.list.gz" ))  # read mothur's asv list file into data.frame asv_data <- strollur::read_mothur_list(list = strollur_example(   "final.asv.list.gz" ))  # read mothur's phylotype list file into data.frame phylo_data <- strollur::read_mothur_list(list = strollur_example(   "final.tx.list.gz" ))  # read otu bin representative sequences into a data.frame bin_reps <- readRDS(strollur_example("miseq_representative_sequences.rds"))  # assign 'otu' bins using sequence names strollur::assign(data, table = otu_data, bin_type = "otu") #> Assigned 531 otu bins.  # assign 'asv' bins using sequence names strollur::assign(data, table = asv_data, bin_type = "asv") #> Assigned 2425 asv bins.  # assign 'phylotype' bins using sequence names strollur::assign(data, table = phylo_data, bin_type = "phylotype") #> Assigned 63 phylotype bins.  # assign 'otu' bin representative sequences strollur::assign(data, table = bin_reps, type = "bin_representative") #> Assigned 531 otu bin representative sequences.  # To assign abundance only bins  # create a new empty strollur object named 'example_dataset' data <- strollur::new_dataset(dataset_name = "example_dataset")  # read mothur's shared file otu_data <-   strollur::read_mothur_shared(strollur_example("final.opti_mcc.shared"))  # assign abundance only otus parsed by sample strollur::assign(data, table = otu_data, bin_type = "otu") #> Assigned 531 otu bins.  # Assigning bin classifications  # read bin taxonomies otu_data <- strollur::read_mothur_cons_taxonomy(strollur_example(   "final.cons.taxonomy" ))  # assign otu consensus taxonomies strollur::assign(   data,   table = otu_data,   type = "bin_taxonomy", bin_type = "otu" ) #> Assigned 531 otu bin taxonomies.  # Assign treatments  sample_assignments <- readRDS(strollur_example("miseq_sample_design.rds"))  strollur::assign(data, table = sample_assignments, type = "treatment") #> Assigned 19 samples to treatments.  # Assign sample distances  dist_file <- strollur_example("final.opti_mcc.jclass.0.03.column.dist") sample_dists <- readr::read_table(dist_file,   col_names = FALSE,   show_col_types = FALSE ) strollur::assign(data, table = sample_dists, type = "sample_distance") #> Assigned 171 samples distances.

code: miseq <- strollur::miseq_sop_example() #> Added 2425 sequences. #> Assigned 2425 sequence abundances. #> Assigned 2425 sequence taxonomies. #> Assigned 531 otu bins. #> Assigned 2425 asv bins. #> Assigned 63 phylotype bins. #> Assigned 19 samples to treatments. #> Assigned 171 samples distances. #> Assigned 531 otu bin taxonomies. #> Assigned 531 otu bin representative sequences. #> Added a metadata report. #> Added 2 resource references. #> Added a contigs_report report.  # To get the total number of sequences strollur::count(data = miseq, type = "sequence") #> [1] 113963  # To get number of unique sequences strollur::count(data = miseq, type = "sequence", distinct = TRUE) #> [1] 2425  # To get number of unique sequences from samples 'F3D0' and 'F3D1' # Note these sequences will be present in both samples but may be # be present in other samples as well strollur::count(data = miseq, type = "sequence", samples = c("F3D0", "F3D1")) #> [1] 9385  # To get number of unique sequences exclusive to samples 'F3D0' and 'F3D1' # Note sequences are present in both samples and NOT present in any other # samples. strollur::count(   data = miseq, type = "sequence", samples = c("F3D0", "F3D1"),   distinct = TRUE ) #> [1] 2  # To get the number of samples in the dataset strollur::count(data = miseq, type = "sample") #> [1] 19  # To get the number of treatments in the dataset strollur::count(data = miseq, type = "treatment") #> [1] 2  # To get the number of "otu" bins in the dataset strollur::count(data = miseq, type = "bin", bin_type = "otu") #> [1] 531  # To get the number of "asv" bins in the dataset strollur::count(data = miseq, type = "bin", bin_type = "asv") #> [1] 2425  # To get the number of "phylotype" bins in the dataset strollur::count(data = miseq, type = "bin", bin_type = "phylotype") #> [1] 63  # To get number of "otu" bins from samples 'F3D0' and 'F3D1' # Note these bins will have sequences from both samples but there may be # other samples present as well strollur::count(   data = miseq,   type = "bin", bin_type = "otu", samples = c("F3D0", "F3D1") ) #> [1] 125  # To get number of "otu" bins unique to samples 'F3D0' and 'F3D1' # Note these bins will have sequences from both samples and NO other samples # will be present in the bins. strollur::count(   data = miseq, type = "bin", bin_type = "otu",   samples = c("F3D0", "F3D1"), distinct = TRUE ) #> [1] 1

Assign sequence classifications  sequence_classifications <- strollur::read_mothur_taxonomy(strollur_example( "final.taxonomy.gz" ))  data$assign(table = sequence_classifications, type = "sequence_taxonomy")  # Assigning bins  # read mothur's otu list file into data.frame otu_data <- strollur::read_mothur_list(list = strollur_example(   "final.opti_mcc.list.gz" ))  # read mothur's asv list file into data.frame asv_data <- strollur::read_mothur_list(list = strollur_example(   "final.asv.list.gz" ))  # Note sequences are present in both samples and NOT present in # any other samples.  miseq$count(type = "sequence",             samples = c("F3D0", "F3D1"), distinct = TRUE )  # To get the number of samples in the dataset miseq$count(type = "sample")  # To get the number of treatments in the dataset miseq$count(type = "treatment")  # To get the number of "otu" bins in the dataset miseq$count(type = "bin", bin_type = "otu")  # To get the number of "asv" bins in the dataset miseq$count(type = "bin", bin_type = "asv")  # To get the number of "phylotype" bins in the dataset miseq$count(type = "bin", bin_type = "phylotype")  # To get number of "otu" bins from samples 'F3D0' and 'F3D1' # Note these bins will have sequences from both samples but there may be # other samples present as well miseq$count(   type = "bin", bin_type = "otu", samples = c("F3D0", "F3D1") )  # To get number of "otu" bins unique to samples 'F3D0' and 'F3D1' # Note these bins will have sequences from both samples and NO other # samples will be present in the bins.  miseq$count(   type = "bin", bin_type = "otu",   samples = c("F3D0", "F3D1"), distinct = TRUE )

To the total abundance for each sequence miseq$abundance(type = "sequence") |> head(n = 5) #>                                  sequence_name abundance #> 1  M00967_43_000000000-A3JHG_1_1101_10133_8460       620 #> 2 M00967_43_000000000-A3JHG_1_1101_10331_23332         1 #> 3 M00967_43_000000000-A3JHG_1_1101_10382_22128         1 #> 4 M00967_43_000000000-A3JHG_1_1101_11035_15765         1 #> 5 M00967_43_000000000-A3JHG_1_1101_11348_22601         2  # To the total abundance for each sequence parsed by sample miseq$abundance(type = "sequence", by_sample = TRUE) |> head(n = 5) #>                                 sequence_name abundance sample treatment #> 1 M00967_43_000000000-A3JHG_1_1101_10133_8460        32   F3D0     Early #> 2 M00967_43_000000000-A3JHG_1_1101_10133_8460       127   F3D1     Early #> 3 M00967_43_000000000-A3JHG_1_1101_10133_8460         1 F3D146      Late #> 4 M00967_43_000000000-A3JHG_1_1101_10133_8460         1 F3D149      Late #> 5 M00967_43_000000000-A3JHG_1_1101_10133_8460         1 F3D150      Late  # To the total abundance for each "otu" bin miseq$abundance(type = "bin", bin_type = "otu") |> head(n = 5) #>   otu_id abundance #> 1 Otu001     12288 #> 2 Otu002      8892 #> 3 Otu003      7794 #> 4 Otu004      7476 #> 5 Otu005      7450  # To the total abundance for each "otu" bin parsed by sample miseq$abundance(type = "bin", bin_type = "otu", by_sample = TRUE) |> head(n = 5) #>   bin_name abundance sample treatment #> 1   Otu001       499   F3D0     Early #> 2   Otu001       351   F3D1     Early #> 3   Otu001       388 F3D141      Late #> 4   Otu001       244 F3D142      Late #> 5   Otu001       189 F3D143      Late  # To the total abundance for each "asv" bin miseq$abundance(type = "bin", bin_type = "asv") |> head(n = 5) #>    asv_id abundance #> 1 Asv0001     12196 #> 2 Asv0002      8829 #> 3 Asv0003      7698 #> 4 Asv0004      7436 #> 5 Asv0005      7307  # To the total abundance for each "asv" bin parsed by sample miseq$abundance(type = "bin", bin_type = "asv", by_sample = TRUE) |> head(n = 5) #>   bin_name abundance sample treatment #> 1  Asv0001       495   F3D0     Early #> 2  Asv0001       340   F3D1     Early #> 3  Asv0001       386 F3D141      Late #> 4  Asv0001       242 F3D142      Late #> 5  Asv0001       188 F3D143      Late  # To the total abundance for each sample miseq$abundance(type = "sample") |> head(n = 5) #>   sample abundance #> 1   F3D0      6191 #> 2   F3D1      4652 #> 3 F3D141      4656 #> 4 F3D142      2423 #> 5 F3D143      2403  # To the total abundance for each treatment miseq$abundance(type = "treatment") #>   treatment abundance #> 1     Early     55634 #> 2      Late     58329   ## ------------------------------------------------ ## Method `strollur$add()` ## ------------------------------------------------   fasta_data <- strollur::read_fasta(fasta = strollur_example("final.fasta.gz")) contigs_report <- readRDS(strollur_example("miseq_contigs_report.rds"))  # Create a new empty `strollur::strollur` object named 'example_dataset' data <- strollur::strollur$new(name = "example_dataset")  data$add(table = fasta_data, type = "sequence") #> Added 2425 sequences. data$add(   table = contigs_report, type = "report",   report_type = "contigs_report", list(sequence_name = "Name") ) #> Added a contigs_report report.  # To add metadata related to your study  metadata <- readRDS(strollur_example("miseq_metadata.rds"))  data$add(table = metadata, type = "report", report_type = "metadata") #> Added a metadata report.  # To add a tree relating to your sequences  tree <- ape::read.tree(strollur_example("final.phylip.tre.gz"))  data$add(table = tree, type = "sequence_tree")  # To add a tree relating to your samples data <- strollur::strollur$new(name = "example_dataset")  df <- strollur::read_mothur_shared(strollur_example("final.opti_mcc.shared")) data$assign(table = df, type = "bin", bin_type = "otu") #> Assigned 531 otu bins.  tree <- ape::read.tree(strollur_example("final.opti_mcc.jclass.ave.tre"))  data$add(table = tree, type = "sample_tree")  # Create a new empty `strollur::strollur` object named 'example_dataset' data <- strollur::strollur$new(name = "example_dataset")  # Read FASTQ data into data.frame fastq_data <-     strollur::read_fastq(fastq = strollur_example("tiny.fastq.gz"))  # Add FASTQ sequence data data$add(table = fastq_data, type = "fastq") #> Added 3 sequences. #> Assigned 3 quality scores.   ## ------------------------------------------------ ## Method `strollur$alignment_length()` ## ------------------------------------------------   data <- strollur::miseq_sop_example() #> Added 2425 sequences. #> Assigned 2425 sequence abundances. #> Assigned 2425 sequence taxonomies. #> Assigned 531 otu bins. #> Assigned 2425 asv bins. #> Assigned 63 phylotype bins. #> Assigned 19 samples to treatments. #> Assigned 171 samples distances. #> Assigned 531 otu bin taxonomies. #> Assigned 531 otu bin representative sequences. #> Added a metadata report. #> Added 2 resource references. #> Added a contigs_report report. data$alignment_length() #> [1] 375   ## ------------------------------------------------ ## Method `strollur$assign()` ## ------------------------------------------------   # create a new empty strollur object named 'example_dataset'  data <- strollur::strollur$new(name = "example_dataset")  # Assign sequence abundances  abundance_by_sample <- strollur::read_mothur_count(strollur_example(   "final.count_table.gz" ))  data$assign(table = abundance_by_sample, type = "sequence_abundance") #> Assigned 2425 sequence abundances.  # Assign sequence classifications  sequence_classifications <- strollur::read_mothur_taxonomy(strollur_example( "final.taxonomy.gz" ))  data$assign(table = sequence_classifications, type = "sequence_taxonomy") #> Assigned 2425 sequence taxonomies.  # Assigning bins  # read mothur's otu list file into data.frame otu_data <- strollur::read_mothur_list(list = strollur_example(   "final.opti_mcc.list.gz" ))  # read mothur's asv list file into data.frame asv_data <- strollur::read_mothur_list(list = strollur_example(   "final.asv.list.gz" ))  # read mothur's phylotype list file into data.frame phylo_data <- strollur::read_mothur_list(list = strollur_example(   "final.tx.list.gz" ))  # read otu bin representative sequences into a data.frame bin_reps <- readRDS(strollur_example(                         "miseq_representative_sequences.rds"))  # assign 'otu' bins using sequence names data$assign(table = otu_data, bin_type = "otu") #> Assigned 531 otu bins.  # assign 'asv' bins using sequence names data$assign(table = asv_data, bin_type = "asv") #> Assigned 2425 asv bins.  # assign 'phylotype' bins using sequence names data$assign(table = phylo_data, bin_type = "phylotype") #> Assigned 63 phylotype bins.  # assign 'otu' bin representative sequences data$assign(table = bin_reps, type = "bin_representative") #> Assigned 531 otu bin representative sequences.  # To assign abundance only bins  # create a new empty strollur object named 'example_dataset' data <- strollur::strollur$new(name = "example_dataset")  # read mothur's shared file otu_data <- strollur::read_mothur_shared(strollur_example("final.opti_mcc.shared"))  # assign abundance only otus parsed by sample data$assign(table = otu_data, bin_type = "otu") #> Assigned 531 otu bins.  # Assigning bin classifications  # read bin taxonomies otu_data <- strollur::read_mothur_cons_taxonomy(strollur_example(   "final.cons.taxonomy" ))  # assign otu consensus taxonomies data$assign(   table = otu_data,   type = "bin_taxonomy", bin_type = "otu" ) #> Assigned 531 otu bin taxonomies.  # Assign treatments  sample_assignments <- readRDS(    strollur_example("miseq_sample_design.rds"))  data$assign(table = sample_assignments, type = "treatment") #> Assigned 19 samples to treatments.  # Assign sample distances  dist_file <- strollur_example("final.opti_mcc.jclass.0.03.column.dist") sample_dists <- readr::read_table(dist_file,                                   col_names = FALSE,                                   show_col_types = FALSE) data$assign(table = sample_dists, type = "sample_distance") #> Assigned 171 samples distances.   ## ------------------------------------------------ ## Method `strollur$clear()` ## ------------------------------------------------  miseq <- strollur::load_dataset(strollur_example("miseq_sop.rds")) miseq #> miseq_sop: #>  #>             starts ends nbases ambigs polymers numns   numseqs #> Minimum:         1  375    249      0        3     0      1.00 #> 2.5%-tile:       1  375    252      0        4     0   2850.05 #> 25%-tile:        1  375    252      0        4     0  28491.50 #> Median:          1  375    253      0        4     0  56982.00 #> 75%-tile:        1  375    253      0        5     0  85472.50 #> 97.5%-tile:      1  375    254      0        6     0 111113.95 #> Maximum:         1  375    256      0        6     0 113963.00 #> Mean:            1  375    252      0        4     0  56982.00 #>  #> Number of unique seqs: 2425  #> Total number of seqs: 113963  #>  #> Total number of samples: 19  #> Total number of treatments: 2  #> Total number of otus: 531  #> Total number of otu bin classifications: 531  #> Total number of asvs: 2425  #> Total number of asv bin classifications: 2425  #> Total number of phylotypes: 63  #> Total number of phylotype bin classifications: 63  #> Total number of sequence classifications: 2425  #> Total number of resource references: 2  #> Total number of custom reports: 2  #>  miseq$clear() miseq #>  #> Total number of seqs: 0  #>  #>   ## ------------------------------------------------ ## Method `strollur$count()` ## ------------------------------------------------   miseq <- strollur::load_dataset(strollur_example("miseq_sop.rds"))  # To get the total number of sequences miseq$count(type = "sequence") #> [1] 113963  # To get number of unique sequences miseq$count(type = "sequence", distinct = TRUE) #> [1] 2425  # To get number of unique sequences from samples 'F3D0' and 'F3D1' # Note these sequences will be present in both samples but may be # be present in other samples as well miseq$count(type = "sequence", samples = c("F3D0", "F3D1")) #> [1] 9385  # To get number of unique sequences exclusive to samples 'F3D0' and # 'F3D1'. Note sequences are present in both samples and NOT present in # any other samples.  miseq$count(type = "sequence",             samples = c("F3D0", "F3D1"), distinct = TRUE ) #> [1] 2  # To get the number of samples in the dataset miseq$count(type = "sample") #> [1] 19  # To get the number of treatments in the dataset miseq$count(type = "treatment") #> [1] 2  # To get the number of "otu" bins in the dataset miseq$count(type = "bin", bin_type = "otu") #> [1] 531  # To get the number of "asv" bins in the dataset miseq$count(type = "bin", bin_type = "asv") #> [1] 2425  # To get the number of "phylotype" bins in the dataset miseq$count(type = "bin", bin_type = "phylotype") #> [1] 63  # To get number of "otu" bins from samples 'F3D0' and 'F3D1' # Note these bins will have sequences from both samples but there may be # other samples present as well miseq$count(   type = "bin", bin_type = "otu", samples = c("F3D0", "F3D1") ) #> [1] 125  # To get number of "otu" bins unique to samples 'F3D0' and 'F3D1' # Note these bins will have sequences from both samples and NO other # samples will be present in the bins.  miseq$count(   type = "bin", bin_type = "otu",   samples = c("F3D0", "F3D1"), distinct = TRUE ) #> [1] 1   ## ------------------------------------------------ ## Method `strollur$get_bin_types()` ## ------------------------------------------------   data <- report. #> Added 2 resource references. #> Added a contigs_report report. data$get_bin_types() #> [1] "otu"       "asv"       "phylotype"   ## ------------------------------------------------ ## title: Find the number of sequences, samples, treatments or bins of a given type in a strollur object — xdev_count
text: data strollur object type string containing type data want number . Options include: "sequence", "sample", "treatment", "bin" "resource_reference". Default = "otu". samples vector strings. samples used 'type' = "sequence" 'type' = "bin" . samples contain names samples want count . Default = NULL. distinct Boolean. distinct used 'type' = "sequence" 'type' = "bin". 'type' = "sequence" distinct TRUE number unique sequences returned. 'type' = "sequence" distinct FALSE total number sequences returned. can also combined samples find number unique sequences found given set samples, find total number sequences given set samples. 'type' = "bin", can set distinct = TRUE return number bins contain sequences given samples. distinct FALSE count returned contains bins sequences given samples, bins may also contain samples. Default = FALSE.

text: double

title: Find the number of sequences, samples, treatments or bins of a given type in a strollur object — xdev_count
code: miseq <- strollur::miseq_sop_example() #> Added 2425 sequences. #> Assigned 2425 sequence abundances. #> Assigned 2425 sequence taxonomies. #> Assigned 531 otu bins. #> Assigned 2425 asv bins. #> Assigned 63 phylotype bins. #> Assigned 19 samples to treatments. #> Assigned 171 samples distances. #> Assigned 531 otu bin taxonomies. #> Assigned 531 otu bin representative sequences. #> Added a metadata report. #> Added 2 resource references. #> Added a contigs_report report.  # To get the total number of sequences strollur::xdev_count(data = miseq,                        type = "sequence") #> [1] 113963  # To get number of unique sequences strollur::xdev_count(data = miseq,                        type = "sequence", distinct = TRUE) #> [1] 2425  # To get number of unique sequences from samples 'F3D0' and 'F3D1' # Note these sequences will be present in both samples but may be # be present in other samples as well strollur::xdev_count(data = miseq,                        type = "sequence",                        samples = c("F3D0", "F3D1")) #> [1] 9385  # To get number of unique sequences exclusive to samples 'F3D0' and 'F3D1' # Note these sequences are present in both samples and NOT present in # other samples strollur::xdev_count(data = miseq,                        type = "sequence",                        samples = c("F3D0", "F3D1"),                        distinct = TRUE) #> [1] 2  # To get the number of samples in the dataset strollur::xdev_count(data = miseq, type = "sample") #> [1] 19  # To get the number of treatments in the dataset strollur::xdev_count(data = miseq, type = "treatment") #> [1] 2  # To get the number of "otu" bins in the dataset strollur::xdev_count(data = miseq,                        type = "bin",                        bin_type = "otu") #> [1] 531  # To get the number of "asv" bins in the dataset strollur::xdev_count(data = miseq,                        type = "bin",                        bin_type = "asv") #> [1] 2425  # To get the number of "phylotype" bins in the dataset strollur::xdev_count(data = miseq,                        type = "bin",                        bin_type = "phylotype") #> [1] 63  # To get number of bins from samples 'F3D0' and 'F3D1' # Note these bins will have sequences from both samples but there may be # other samples present as well strollur::xdev_count(data = miseq,                        type = "bin",                        samples = c("F3D0", "F3D1")) #> [1] 125  # To get number of bins unique to samples 'F3D0' and 'F3D1' # Note these bins will have sequences from both samples and NO other samples # will be present in the bins. strollur::xdev_count(data = miseq,                        type = "bin",                        samples = c("F3D0", "F3D1"),                        distinct = TRUE) #> [1] 1

title: strollur 0.1.4
text: New Features: strollur::read_fastq() returns data.frame fastq data. strollur::write_fastq() writes fastq data file. strollur::read_quality() returns data.frame sequence quality data. strollur::write_quality() writes sequence quality data file. strollur::read_biom() returns strollur_object. strollur::write_biom() writes biom files containing strollur_object. strollur_object$alignment_length() returns sequences alignment length -1 sequences unaligned. strollur_object$has_bin_taxonomy() returns TRUE dataset includes bin classifications. strollur_object$has_sequence_taxonomy() returns TRUE dataset includes sequence classifications. strollur_object$rename() rename strollur object. Enhancements: strollur::report() strollur_object$report() strollur::add() strollur_object$add() strollur::assign() strollur_object$assign() Functions Package developers Adds strollur::xdev_alignment_length() function Adds strollur::xdev_assign_bin_taxonomy_tidy() function. Adds strollur::xdev_has_bin_taxonomy() function. Adds strollur::xdev_get_sequence_indexes_by_sample() function. Adds strollur::xdev_add_sequence_fastq_scores() function. Adds strollur::xdev_get_sample_distances() function. Adds strollur::xdev_assign_sample_distances() function. Bug Fixes: - strollur::summary() now display results accurately represent data. Deprecated: Removes strollur_object$add_sequence_tree() : Functionality now included instrollur_object$add(). Removes strollur_object$add_sample_tree() : Functionality now included instrollur_object$add(). Removes strollur_object$get_sequence_tree() : Functionality now included instrollur_object$report(). Removes strollur_object$get_sample_tree() : Functionality now included instrollur_object$report().
